skill_name: Create a reinterpretation of the following painting.
workflow: My reinterpretation of The Mona Lisa by Leonardo Da Vinci is an abstract portrait composed of colorful geometric shapes, swirls and curves. The bright lines suggest movement and energy, and the bold colors hint at optimism and joy. I have chosen to make the woman in the painting larger than in the original to emphasize her status as a powerful and self-possessed individual.
